# ethereum-optimism/op-geth Daily Update (Jul 31, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
Today, a significant update was made to block header and hash calculations, adding 'bal' to the process. Additionally, numerous issues related to the deprecated `op-program` and the "Standard L2 Genesis" initiative were closed as not planned or superseded.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

- **Block Header and Hash Calculation Update**
  - The 'bal' field has been integrated into the block header and hash calculation process, affecting core types, genesis, and beacon engine components. ([#804](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/pull/804))

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
- No new pull requests were opened today.

## CLOSED ISSUES

- **Deprecation of `op-program` Related Issues**
  - Several issues concerning `op-program` features, testing, and configuration were closed as not planned due to its removal from the monorepo in favor of the Rust `kona-client`. This includes issues related to building with custom configs ([#15944](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/15944)), prestate creation ([#15965](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/15965)), Go SSA analysis ([#11229](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/11229)), hash scheme dependency removal ([#11551](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/11551)), TinyGo compilation ([#11548](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/11548)), non-determinism sanitization ([#11667](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/11667)), host request timeouts ([#12678](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/12678)), consolidation step bypass ([#15205](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/15205)), transitionState sanity checks ([#15199](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/15199)), test setup failures ([#15220](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/15220)), reproducible prestate issues ([#15273](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/15273)), reproducibility verification ([#17156](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/17156)), and engine API checks ([#17336](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/17336)).
- **Standard L2 Genesis Initiative Updates**
  - A large number of issues related to the "Standard L2 Genesis" effort were closed as not planned or superseded. This includes modifications to `FeeVault` ([#12297](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/12297)), `OptimismPortal` ([#12298](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/12298)), `CrossDomainMessenger` ([#12300](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/12300)), `SuperchainConfig` upgrader role ([#12305](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/12305)), failure mode analysis ([#12296](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/12296)), Isthmus tracking ([#12302](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/12302)), L1 contracts using OZ v5 Initializable ([#12655](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/12655)), L2BlockGasLimit buffer prevention ([#12578](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/12578)), start block misconfiguration prevention ([#12579](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/12579)), Semgrep rule for non-initializable predeploys ([#12580](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/12580)), L2 Genesis file generation ([#12708](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/12708)), `uprgrader` role renaming ([#12861](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/12861)), `setFeeVaultConfig` calls to `SystemConfig.init` ([#13038](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/13038)), audit findings review ([#13043](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/13043)), and upgrade path testing ([#13341](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/13341)).
- **Contract and Deployment Tooling Refinements**
  - Issues related to `FaultDisputeGame.sol`'s immutable `L2_CHAIN_ID` ([#11323](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/11323)) and `op-deployer` package separation ([#11925](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/11925)) were closed as completed. Other issues, such as `AnchorStateRegistry` event emission ([#11496](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/11496)), L2 Contracts Release ([#11778](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/11778)), Contract Versioning Tool ([#11907](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/11907)), `op-deployer` build/usage issues ([#13939](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/13939)), and `deploy-config.json` errors with tag v1.8.0 ([#13966](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/13966)) were closed as not planned or obsolete.
- **Miscellaneous Closed Issues**
  - Issues regarding L2 Genesis Simplification ([#11558](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/11558)), OPCM gas usage testing ([#13021](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/13021)), OPCM bounty and audit processes ([#14055](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/14055)), and a checklist for shipping contracts to prod ([#13228](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/13228)) were closed as not planned or superseded. A withdrawal transaction stuck at `READY_TO_PROVE` status ([#13466](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/13466)) was closed as a deprecated SDK support request. The issue of adding a default label `M-needs-triage` to issues ([#13647](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/13647)) was closed as completed. An issue with Optimism `mise` install error ([#17963](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/17963)) was closed as not planned due to changes in `mise.toml` entries.

## NEW ISSUES
- **Lagoon Upgrade Gas Divergence**
  - A new issue highlights a 150k gas divergence between `op-node` and `kona` during the Lagoon upgrade, where they strip different amounts of upgrade gas than they add. This divergence is currently not caught by existing CI tests. ([#22166](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/22166))

## ACTIVE ISSUES

- **opgeth-decoupling: check-* fork tools — delete stale checkers, swap the rest to op-core** ([#21746](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/21746))
  - The discussion today focused on the progress of decoupling `op-geth`. Specifically, the `check-derivation` tool, which previously used `types.NewIsthmusSigner`, has been deleted, resolving a scope addition from July 20th. The remaining work involves swapping other checker tools to `op-core`, which is being tracked in [#22162](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/22162) and implemented by [#22163](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/pull/22163).
- **Lagoon upgrade gas: op-node and kona strip a different amount than they add (150k divergence)** ([#22166](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/22166))
